This position serves as a primary customer point of contact for the installation and training of Pharmacy Management, Point of Sale, and TelePharm Systems. You will work closely with the implementation, hardware, and project management teams to successfully onboard and train pharmacy clients. Key responsibilities include traveling on-site to implement software and hardware, and to train new or converted PMS, POS, and/or TelePharm customers during their onboarding. It is essential to represent the organization professionally, maintain patience, demonstrate a positive attitude, and possess strong skills in training and communicating with end users.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conduct remote and on-site system installation and deliver software and hardware training to customers
* Lead pre-installation calls with customers to review processes, set expectations, and address customer questions
* Gather and verify all required information prior to go-live, coordinating pre-installation conference calls and communicating with the Project Manager as needed
* Perform basic computer setup, configuration, and networking
* Troubleshoot issues to determine whether networks, workstations, or peripheral hardware are responding correctly to the program’s instructions
* Serve as a responsive point of contact for Outcomes customers during the implementation process
* Multi-task, prioritize, and manage multiple projects efficiently
* Ensure all required documentation is completed and submitted on time throughout the implementation process
* Prepare and submit accurate expense reports promptly
* Assist in documenting and maintaining SOPs at the manager’s discretion
* Participate in occasional internal project work as assigned by the manager
* Perform additional tasks as needed based on specific installation or training requirements

**COMPLEXITY OF TASKS**

* Complexity of tasks: Medium - works on problems of moderate scope which are often varied and routine

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Regular business hours, Monday – Friday. Workweek is typically 40+ hours and may extend to 12+ hours on certain days depending on workload and project scope. Flexible hours may include evenings and some weekends. Weekends duties may include travel on Saturdays and travel plus installation on Sundays
* Travel Requirements: Domestic and/or international, up to 100% of the time

**KNOWLEDGE & REQUIREMENTS**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both customers and team members
* Ability to remain positive, calm, and professional under pressure or in stressful situations
* Strong, approachable presence with a willingness to assist others
* Demonstrated strong work ethic and self motivation
* Proven problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze situations, think critically, and develop effective solutions
* Ability to visualize complex issues think abstractly identify resolutions
* Team-oriented mindset with a collaborative approach
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum of 2 years of customer service experience, preferably in the healthcare field
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience

The physical demands described below are representative of those an employee must meet to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

* Frequent sitting in stationary position at a desk
* Occasional standing, walking, stooping, kneeling, squatting, and climbing stairs
* Occasional twisting or turning of the body
* Occasional reaching by extending hands and arms in any direction
* Occasional lifting, pulling, or pushing of objects up to 40 lbs

* HSA & FSA
* Fertility & Family Planning Benefits
* Paid Parental Leave
* Adoption Assistance Program
* Employee Resource Groups
* Flex PTO for Exempt Associates & up to 15 PTO days in first year of employment for non-exempt associates

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Consultant, Fire Prevention**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Manager, Implementation Consulting  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $80,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Implementation Consultant, Fire Prevention US owns the configuration, deployment, and customer enablement of First Due's Fire Prevention suite across the US customer base, with primary delivery in the Core segment, on-call complex-configuration support to Essentials, and contribution to Enterprise engagements. Fire Prevention is one of First Due's most configuration-intensive modules. The role demands command of fire inspection and code enforcement practice, including inspections, permitting, invoicing, investigations, and the inspection, testing, and maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems. This role is accountable for translating an agency's prevention and code enforcement program into a correct, maintainable First Due configuration and for a training and go-live experience that earns inspector and administrator adoption.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

#### **Module configuration and delivery**

* Configure inspection programs, including occupancy records, inspection types and routes, code-based checklists, and scheduling aligned to the agency's adopted fire code (NFPA 1, IFC, or local amendments).
* Configure permitting, including operational and burn permits, application and review workflows, and renewals.
* Configure invoicing and fee collection across permits, inspections, and other billable prevention activities.
* Configure inspection, testing, and maintenance (ITM) workflows for fire protection systems, including third-party contractor report submission, deficiency tracking, and compliance follow-up.
* Configure fire investigation workflows, including cause and origin documentation.
* Configure code enforcement, violations, and plan review, including violation tracking, notices, re-inspection cycles, and new-construction review routing.

#### **Project execution and product partnership**

* Partner with the assigned Implementation Manager to deliver Fire Prevention milestones on plan, surfacing risks early.
* Maintain accurate project status, level-of-effort actuals, and configuration documentation in Rocketlane.
* Serve as the Fire Prevention subject matter expert on assigned projects across segments.
* Surface product gaps, defects, and field-driven enhancement requests for Fire Prevention to the Team Manager and Product organization.

* Excellent communication, training delivery, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience with Rocketlane or a comparable professional services delivery platform.

* Direct experience as a fire inspector, fire marshal or deputy fire marshal, plans examiner, fire investigator, or company officer with inspection duties.

* Guide hotels through required identity and business verification (KYC), then hand properties off to Market Managers.
* Take work in from several Account Executives and coordinate handoffs to several Market Managers.

* Teach partners how the platform works, and build strong, lasting partner relationships.
* Act as a responsive "front desk" for hotel partners: triage their requests and give timely, high-quality service.
* Find ways to manage and streamline workflows.

* 3+ years of experience in account management, partner support or partner onboarding.
* Very strong attention to detail.
* Strong organizational skills, including keeping a large pipeline of work moving across several stages.

This role is remote within the US, ideally based in the Eastern or Central time zone, with regular travel to customer sites around technical workshops, trial loads, and cutover.
